sentences.en: The most incredible thing about miracles is that they happen.
sentences.zh: 奇迹最不可思议的地方在于它们真的会发生。

sentences.en: What an incredible amount of work he has done!
sentences.zh: 他所做的工作真是难以置信多！

sentences.en: The Beatles set the world on fire with their incredible music.
sentences.zh: 披头士乐队凭借他们的音乐让整个世界为之疯狂。

senses.zh: 不能相信的, 不可信的 - 〈非正〉难以置信的, 不可思议的, 惊人的
